nodes.title: 制作输出 · 正向物理时间外推 (+3秒)

metadata.prompt: Predict and generate the physically logical next moment occurring exactly 3 seconds after the supplied image. Extrapolate realistic momentum and physics: advance ongoing character body movement, follow the vector of gaze, propagate physical phenomena such as smoke dispersal, liquid splashes, falling objects, vehicle displacement and natural environmental reactions. Preserve the exact identity, facial features, hairstyle, clothing, body proportions, materials, color grading and art style of the supplied image. Maintain strict continuity of character identity, costume, lighting direction and environment setting. Do not add text, captions, watermarks, logos or frame borders.

nodes.title: 制作说明 · 正向物理时间外推 (+3秒)

metadata.content:
模板说明：正向物理时间外推 (+3秒)
请先在“上传原图”节点导入对应原始图片，再使用“制作输出”节点。
这是可复制的原生制作模板，不是已生成的成片案例；当前图片状态为未生成，也没有封面、模型、渠道或费用配置。
原始比例：源码未提供固定比例；复制后请先选择与原图对应的画幅，本模板不自动推断或保持比例，不预设 size
来源文件：03_画板视觉矩阵提示词/原生画板12组视觉矩阵提示词源码.md
来源 SHA256：f68de06d35341ee3c4460e29e14ac41e43318653fa6b33c8b371d21c3e2edba2
原始片段（仅作可追溯内容，不执行）：
```javascript
{
  scene: "frame-prediction-plus-3s",
  prompt: [
    "Predict and generate the physically logical next moment occurring exactly 3 seconds after the supplied image.",
    "Extrapolate realistic momentum and physics: advance ongoing character body movement, follow the vector of gaze, propagate physical phenomena such as smoke dispersal, liquid splashes, falling objects, vehicle displacement and natural environmental reactions.",
    qa,
    "Maintain strict continuity of character identity, costume, lighting direction and environment setting.",
    Xa
  ].join(" ")
}
```
